notes.title: Clever Plays Studio is Thrilled to Announce Our New Game: Happy Bastards!
notes.content:
[h2]Clever Plays Studio is Thrilled to Announce Our New Game: Happy Bastards![/h2]

Gear up and get ready for a wild ride through a world where chaos reigns supreme and only the unruliest survive. We are beyond excited to introduce you to Happy Bastards, our newly revealed open-world tactical RPG with turn-based combat. Assemble your squad of mercenaries, each more unpredictable and audacious than the last, to explore, fight, and loot your way to fame and fortune! [b]Who needs XP when you’re famous?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/809e9071104e9ec2366c9d8d378d5706be0111c9.png[/img]

In Happy Bastards, you call the shots. Lead your team of raucous rogues as they get their hands dirty doing the jobs no one else would dare. Who needs XP when you’re famous? 


[h2][b]Key Features: [/b][/h2]

[b]Fame is the Name of the Game[/b]
Why risk lifting a sword when your disposable mercs can do all the dirty work? Just rely on your silver tongue and shamelessness to build your claim to fame, one flashy act at a time.

[b]Tend to Your Unruly Bastards[/b]
These ruthless warriors are as dumb as a bag of rocks. Be prepared to babysit in and out of combat as your bastards argue, cause mischief, and speak their minds. Who said being the boss would be easy?

[b]Be Hands-On at Arm's Length[/b]
Shout commands from a safe distance while your bastards execute each of your combat tactics. Whether ordering a perfectly-timed tag-team ability or sacrificing a human meat shield, you make the call--but never take the fall.

[b]All the Scheming, None of the Guilt[/b]
Lead a morally-bankrupt campaign across a parody-filled fantasy world. Every town, hero, and monster faction can be turned ally or foe, so choose wisely because you'll have to live--and your bastards likely die--with the consequences.


We’re truly excited for all that is coming on this Happy Bastards’ journey and hope that you will join this merry band of devs on our quest to make a fantastic game for you! 

This doesn't mean we're closing the door completely on additional Operation:Tango content, but the team is excited to explore a new genre and gameplay style with Happy Bastards!

Please Wishlist the Game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2964560/Happy_Bastards/ ]Steam[/url]. 
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/CleverPlays 
Join the Discord: Discord.gg/CleverPlays  



Thank you, 

LizMac and the Clever Plays Team

notes.title: Teamwork is Dreamwork Bundle Launch!
notes.content:
[h2]We’re happy to announce a brand new co-op bundle: “Teamwork is Dreamwork!”[/h2]

The [url=https://bit.ly/TeamDreamBundle]"Teamwork is Dreamwork Bundle"[/url] includes four exciting video games: Operation:Tango, BiPed, Ship of Fools, and Pico Park. Each of these games is designed to be played with friends or family members, and they all require teamwork to succeed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/546fe850e98cee366d6876e000b96a019b06755d.png[/img]

[b]Operation:Tango[/b] is a thrilling spy-themed game that requires players to work together to complete dangerous missions. One player takes on the role of an agent in the field, while the other acts as a hacker, providing support from a remote location. Together, they must infiltrate enemy strongholds, gather intelligence, and complete other high-stakes objectives. The game features beautiful graphics, challenging puzzles, and plenty of laughs with your player two!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/251a42e8be7d8e45d38b3765d8cc3ee499e39273.png[/img]

[b]BiPed[/b] is a cooperative puzzle-platformer that requires players to control two robots that work together to overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. The game features beautiful environments, fun gameplay mechanics, and a charming soundtrack that will keep players engaged for hours on end. With over 30 levels to explore, BiPed is a game that will challenge even the most skilled players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/505e23d9ab8acc7d3a1f127f1ee233c5b27f11d9.png[/img]

[b]Ship of Fools[/b] is a party game that's perfect for groups of friends or family members. Players take on the roles of sailors on a ship, and they must work together to navigate treacherous waters, avoid obstacles, and stay alive. The game features colourful graphics, hilarious animations, and a variety of minigames that will keep players laughing and having fun for hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/dc4c370382eb179c9d20841b3e2f85d2d382f3fd.png[/img]

[b]Pico Park[/b] is a multiplayer puzzle game that requires players to work together to solve challenging puzzles. The game features minimalist graphics and simple controls, but don't let that fool you: Pico Park is a game that requires careful planning, communication, and teamwork to succeed. With over 40 levels to explore, Pico Park is a game that will keep players going for hours.

The [url=https://bit.ly/TeamDreamBundle]"Teamwork is Dreamwork Bundle"[/url] is perfect for anyone who loves to play games with friends or family members. Whether you're looking for a thrilling spy adventure, a challenging puzzle-platformer, a hilarious party game, or a cooperative puzzle game, this bundle has something for everyone.

[h3]Already own one, or some, of the games? Don’t worry! Steam automatically adjusts the bundle price to remove any games you already have while you still get to keep that sweet, sweet bundle discount! [/h3]

notes.title: 2022 Wrapped!
notes.content:
[h3][b]What a year 2022 has been! We can't wait for what 2023 has in store, but for now, let's take a look at what we've been up to this last year.[/b][/h3]

[h3]LizMac on the Move[/h3]

This year we sent our community manager out to both PAX East and West! Now that conventions are happening in person again, it was finally time to get to reconnect with our community. From Boston to Seattle, a wonderful time was had! We even got to give a panel talking all about how the pandemic changed co-op games and co-op game development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/5fa02091b612eeced8e8ab1cd6f49329bcf565af.png[/img]

[h3]One year of Tango![/h3]

We celebrated Operation:Tango's first birthday with giveaways, community streams, Discord parties and more! It was fantastic to have the community celebrating with us. Operation:Tango is absolutely a labour of love and we are so proud of the game, and of the community that has come to love it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/859eed98093a2421bf921caf1a20eac3774bb33b.png[/img]

[h3]Things Got Speedy![/h3]

All year we hosted a Speedrunning challenge in our Discord for the Operation:Tango DLC! We had entrants from all over the world; some were friends, siblings, and others were just random players, all trying to win that top spot! It was exhilarating for us as developers to see how quickly they could speed past, or sometimes through, the challenges we had made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/cf5ef71a4498ba59855ea518b2bacaf9808e54e2.png[/img]

[h3]Repping at the Game Awards[/h3]

Our studio co-founder, Angela, got to represent the Clever Crew at this year’s Game Awards! It was absolutely amazing to see all the reveals of new games, as well as getting to recognize some of the fantastic games to come out this year! 

[b]With that, the 2022 season has come to a close! We can’t wait to see what 2023 brings us and are extremely thankful to have you all along for the ride![/b]

Happy Holidays, 

~LizMac and the Clever Crew

notes.title: It Takes Two To Save The World raises funds to support OxFam
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335790/Operation_Tango/][b]Operation: Tango[/b][/url], you and a friend must work in tandem as Field Agent & Hacker to infiltrate, investigate, and eradicate the forces threatening the free world. [b]Communication and teamwork are key to completing missions, as “It Takes Two to Save the World”.[/b]

But at Clever Plays, that’s so much more than a tagline. To celebrate the release of the playable demo on Steam, [b]we’ve organized the [url=http://www.operation-tango.com/charity]“It Takes Two to Save the World” charity campaign[/url], benefitting Oxfam in their global efforts to fight poverty.[/b]

The concept of the charity is to [b]raise money for each [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/]demo [/url]play-through video we receive[/b], and we already had the pleasure to have many videos from the gaming community! Here are a few we selected : 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VT1YhS_mvy0

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZiRn2sPWl6o

We hope that you enjoyed participating in this great initiative, and if you didn’t have the chance, you still can! notes.title: Announcing Operation: Tango, an Innovative Co-op Spy Adventure
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38051184/1250fe443a9c7ffc0d44b872aa858a52645e4d21.png[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

It’s a great day here at Clever Plays! We’re super excited to finally reveal the project we have been secretly working on for the past 2 years. Here is [b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335790/Operation_Tango/]Operation: Tango[/url][/i][/b], an innovative co-op spy adventure.

With no further ado, [b]check out our first trailer![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ZhV0ACoBOw

[b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335790/Operation_Tango/]Operation: Tango[/url][/i][/b] is an [b]espionage-themed cooperative adventure[/b] challenging you and a friend to complete dangerous missions across the globe in a high-tech near-future world.

As an exclusive team of two, you and your partner will become [b]AGENT[/b] and [b]HACKER[/b], working together to infiltrate, investigate, and eradicate the forces threatening the free world.

[b]Work in tandem from two different points of view[/b] with only your voice to link you. Teamwork is crucial, and [b]communication is key![/b]

Expect a release [b]in 2021[/b] on Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335790/Operation_Tango/]Steam[/url]!

Stay tuned on our social media and [url=www.operation-tango.com]sign up to our monthly newsletter on our website[/url] to get important news regarding the studio and our games!

Cheers,

– Val and the Clever Plays team
